literal_meaning: কোণে ঠাসা বা আটকে পড়া (squeezed or cornered)
example_sentences_in_bangla: কাজে তার কোণঠাসা অবস্থা দেখে দুঃখ হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: He has been sidelined in the team.
It was heartbreaking to see him marginalized at work.
note: Idiom reflects feelings of exclusion common in group dynamics in Bengali culture.
